title: The universal property of the flattening ideal over an Artinian ring
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the universal property of the smallest ideal modulo which a module over an Artinian ring becomes flat: a base change makes the module flat exactly when that ideal is killed. Existence of the ideal is quoted from the companion result. One implication is base change of flatness. For the other, the author takes the kernel of the ring map, uses flatness of the base changed module and the identifications along the quotient by that kernel, applies the descent result for injective maps of Artinian rings to conclude that the module modulo the kernel is flat, and therefore that the flattening ideal is contained in the kernel, which is the assertion.
